Source-bound synthetic explanatory presentation, not a native SysML graphical view.": "SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE / 08 Compare two tool-library approaches Two existing proposals; costs and outcomes remain unverified. Paper ledger + board Private loan record; separate public tools/status board. Handover updates both. K_PAPER Local ledger on laptop Record each handover once; derive a separate tools/status view from the same data. K_LAPTOP Both keep on-duty volunteer authorization. Upfront ceiling: $200; no recurring software budget. Conditional workload, not a wait prediction 10 x 1 x 3 = 30 volunteer-minutes arrivals x transactions/arrival x minutes/transaction 30 work-minutes / 30 available minutes = 100% nominal load Assumes one continuously available volunteer. No final choice. Costs, upkeep and waiting remain unknown. K_PAPER / K_LAPTOP / D_SELECTION remains deferred. Fictional recollections; no measured speed advantage or expected wait."
